_about: Operational data for a take-off from SCEL (Santiago). Companion to scl_operations.md.

_sources.survey: AIP-CHILE VOL I, AD 2 SCEL, AMDT NR 67, 06 AUG 2026 (DGAC Chile) - sections AD 2.2, 2.8, 2.9, 2.12, 2.13, 2.14, 2.20, 2.21 and the SCEL ADC chart AMDT 102 / 14 MAY 2026
_sources.markings_measured: Esri World Imagery, rectified along the RWY 17R axis at 0.25 m/px and measured (see scl_operations.md 'measured' column). Imagery used for measurement only; not redistributed.
_sources.standard: ICAO Annex 14 Vol I, 8th ed. (2018), Chapter 5

frame.origin: RWY 17R threshold - the point where a LATAM departure lines up
frame.axes: x = East, y = North, z = up, metres (local ENU tangent plane, WGS84)

transform_to_the_17L_frame_used_by_scl_o.note: scl_osm.json / lib/frame.py put the origin on the RWY 17L threshold. To convert a point from that frame into this one, add the offset below.

runway_in_use.rule: AIP AD 2.20 1.1-1.5: the runways in use are 17L and 17R. Segregated mode is applied preferentially: RWY 17L for arrivals, RWY 17R for departures. 17L/17R are used with up to 10 kt tailwind. A request for 35R/35L is subject to ATC delay.
runway_in_use.night_exception: AIP AD 2.21 1.1: use of RWY 17R/35L is restricted 00:00-06:00 LMT (exceptions: ICAO Annex 16 Chapter 14 aircraft; landings without reverse; operational-safety cases). Departures in that window therefore go from 17L.
runway_in_use.night_exception_2: AIP AD 2.21 1.2: Chapter 3 aircraft above 50,000 kg MTOW may not take off between 22:00 and 07:00 LMT, on either runway.

markings_rwy_17R_measured_m._method: Esri World Imagery rectified on the 17R axis, 0.25 m sampling; distances are from the published threshold; imagery georeferencing bias is about 2 m.

threshold_stripes.icao: Annex 14 Table in 5.2.4.5: 12 stripes for a 45 m runway; 5.2.4.6: >=30 m long, ~1.80 m wide, ~1.80 m gaps, 2x gap at the centre

designation.pattern: ICAO Annex 14 Fig. 5-2 (B), stacked: the letter R nearer the threshold, the number 17 beyond it
designation.icao: Fig. 5-2 (B): 12 m after the threshold stripes, letter 9 m, 6 m gap, number 9 m

centreline.measured_over: 8 consecutive periods between 1438 m and 1888 m from THR 17R; 59.75-60.25 m
centreline.icao: 5.2.3.3 period 50-75 m, stripe >= max(gap, 30 m); 5.2.3.4 width >= 0.90 m on CAT II/III

aiming_point.icao: Table 5-1 col 5 (LDA >= 2400 m): 400 m from threshold, 45-60 m long, 6-10 m wide, 18-22.5 m spacing

touchdown_zone.pattern: Annex 14 Fig. 5-5 (B) - three stripes per mark
touchdown_zone.icao: 5.2.6.4: pairs every 150 m, six pairs for LDA >= 2400 m, delete any pair within 50 m of the aiming point

side_stripe.icao: 5.2.7.5: >= 0.90 m on runways 30 m or wider

distance_remaining.note: ICAO has no painted distance-remaining marking and none is painted at SCEL. AIP AD 2.9 lists only: designators, centre line, edge, touchdown zone, aiming point, signs, NO ENTRY.

17R.centreline: 3200 m every 15 m white, then red to 3800 m
17R.edge: not published separately for this direction

17L.centreline: white LIH to 2600 m; white/red 2500-3150 m; red 3150-3750 m (as published; the 2600/2500 pair is inconsistent in the AIP)

35R.edge: 600 m red every 60 m; 3200 m white every 60 m LIH

35L.centreline: 3200 m every 15 m white, then red to 3800 m

lighting.abn: TWR aerodrome beacon, flashing white every 10 s, H24
lighting.taxiway: edge and centre-line lighting, or lit and retro-reflective markers plus centre-line lighting (AD 2.15)

taxiways.lvp_pink_spots: LVP position markings (pink spots) are painted WEST of the centre line of TWY ZULU, ALFA, PAPA and KILO: a black alphanumeric on a 3 m pink disc, bounded by a black ring and an outer white ring (AD 2.9 item 5).
taxiways.note: THR 17L sits 528.8 m down-field of THR 17R along the 17R axis; subtract 528.8 to get distances from the 17L threshold.

standard_taxi_routes._source: AIP AD 2 SCEL-46..48, section 14.3 - applies only when 17L/17R are in use

stand_groups.west: cargo W1-W9B, V1, V2; Concourse C (C1A-C5B); Concourse E (E1A-E6B); A12, A12A/B, A13, A13A/B

standard_taxi_routes.yield_rules: Aircraft taxiing on TWY ALFA give way to traffic vacating RWY 17L via BRAVO or CHARLIE; aircraft on TWY ZULU give way to traffic vacating RWY 17R via UNIFORM or WHISKY (AD 2 13.1).
standard_taxi_routes.mrot: Minimum Runway Occupancy Time is in force: an aircraft at the holding point must be ready to line up and start the take-off immediately; otherwise the clearance is cancelled and it is sent off at the first taxiway.

facilities_xy_m._frame: x east / y north from THR 17R; 'along' = distance down the 17R take-off axis, 'east' = metres east of the 17R centre line

Engine run-up Test Area.note: north of TWY PAPA, marked 'Test Area' on the SCEL ADC; full-power runs are not allowed on the apron (AD 2.21)

PDH VOR/DME.note: Pudahuel; the 17R runway track is radial 177 of PDH

sid_first_segment.common: Every 17R departure climbs straight ahead on the runway track (TR 176-177 deg, PDH R177).
sid_first_segment.dilok_guvol_profile: Climb on TR 177 deg to 4000 ft, then turn RIGHT (west) direct SEKSU - TEPOK - TEMUS - TINGO - EL680 - DILOK/GUVOL.
sid_first_segment.why: The recommended SIDs deliberately buy track miles to gain altitude before crossing the Andes (airline route manual).
sid_first_segment.geometry_for_the_scene: 4000 ft = 1219 m AMSL = 745 m above the field; at a typical narrowbody climb that is roughly 5-7 km straight south of the threshold before the first turn, and the turn is to the RIGHT, away from the cordillera.

magnetic.aip_variation: VAR 0.9 deg E (2023), SCEL ADC AMDT 102
magnetic.note: Declination at SCEL is now essentially zero, so true and magnetic tracks coincide within a degree. The 17/35 designation dates from when the easterly declination was large enough for a true track of 177.4 deg to round to 17.
